items.q: and we had Otis -- this alto player.

ctx.x: we'll keep coming." And I was able to fill in with various musicians here and there, to keep the band going. But those were the highlights of 1942.

1943, comes on the scene. We still had the same problem, trying to get musicians. It was a job, trying to get various ones who could play shows and fill the bill. We scuffled, and I heard about a couple of saxophone players in Memphis, Tennessee. One was named Otis White and the other boy's name, we called him Spike. You know his name?
No, I dont know Spike's name.
